name: Ideas Fest 2026
tagline: The festival for business leaders and entrepreneurs

hours.afterDark: Live music and DJ sets until 22:45 both nights: Rick Parfitt Jnr and the RPJ Band on Wednesday, DJ Fat Tony on Thursday. Fire pit sessions after.

travel.road: Just off the A41, about 40 minutes from central London. Parking is pre-booked only: ANPR reads every plate on entry. Your order includes a campervan pitch, so you're sleeping on site both nights.
travel.rail: Nearest station is Tring (Avanti West Coast / London Northwestern), about 35 minutes from London Euston. A shuttle runs between Tring station and the venue.
travel.fromDocShed: From DocShed, Gwynedd allow roughly 4 hours by road (A55 → M56 → M6 → M1/A41). Aim to leave by 04:30 on Wednesday to make gates at 08:00, or travel Tuesday evening.

stages: The Boardroom Powered By CEO Friend
The Engine Room Powered By It Takes Two
notes: All stages and most zones are covered, but it's a festival field: layers and boots.
Sessions move right up to the day. The WhatsApp concierge and the official agenda are the source of truth for room changes.

you.tickets: 2 × two-day passes (UK StartUp Awards finalist rate) plus a campervan pitch. Ticket email from ideasfest@buytickets.at, 17 July.
you.awards: UK StartUp Awards National Final, Wednesday 17:00, Conversations That Matter big top (moved from Real Talk). vedrí is a finalist.
bookings: Zoky Saunascape sauna and plunge, Wednesday 14:00–15:00, Founder Recovery zone. Sign the waiver first.
The Great British Build Off (Macaly AI), Wednesday 13:30–15:00. Access link arrives in the Build Off WhatsApp channel. You forwarded it to Aled.
offers: TableTalk podcast: Ed Fowkes is doing live on-stage interviews with finalists, shown on the big screens. Dylan sent a booking form on 28 August; check whether you filled it in.
Frankie James offered you a go on the decks after you replied to his DJ email.
you.concierge: Ideas Fest WhatsApp concierge (automated): +44 7988 032598. Ask it where a stage is or what's on next.
you.workspace: The Stoneway Workspace Hub is a quiet on-site space for calls and meetings. Walk-ins on the day.
packing: Ticket QR from the buytickets.at email
Swimwear, two towels and water for the sauna
Battery pack: you'll be on your phone all day
Layers and boots for a field in September
The pitch deck link ready to share: vedri.studio/vedri-pitch-deck
